meta.parties: Karthigesu Et Al. v. Parupathy Et Al

rules.statement: An action for pre-emption should be valued on the basis of the sum of money the plaintiff should offer for substitution, which is the price stated in the deed of transfer unless the court has reason to believe that the price given is fictitious.
rules.supporting_quote: "An action for pre-emption being merely an action to assert the right to be substituted in the place of the vendee, should be valued on the basis of the sum of money the plaintiff should offer for that substitution. That amount in this case would be Rs. 300."
